## Change / 改动

What was added, corrected or removed, and why?
新增、修正或删除了什么？为什么？

## Sources / 依据

Link to the project or supporting documentation. Note any installation testing separately.
附项目或文档链接；如果做过安装测试，请单独说明。

## Checks / 检查

Mark completed items only. Use N/A for unrelated checks; list unfinished work below.
只勾选已完成项，不适用的写 N/A；未完成的填在下方。

- [ ] Both READMEs have matching resources and previews / 两版资源与预览一致
- [ ] Links, anchors and images checked / 已检查链接、章节跳转和图片
- [ ] Any maintenance data includes a date / 维护数据已注明日期（如适用）
- [ ] Local catalog checks and tests pass / 本地清单检查与测试通过

## Help needed / 需要帮助

Missing translation, source verification or checks? A single-language draft is welcome.
需要协助翻译、核验来源或运行检查时在此说明，可先提交单语言草稿。
